audience.title: Built for the people who teach, and the students who read it
audience.body: Course kit is for instructors who want a course site that stays current without a web team. Students get one place for the syllabus, the schedule, slides, practice and a glossary, on a phone, a laptop or paper.
points: Instructors keep the course in small JSON files and Markdown, and the site follows.
Students read a calm, high-contrast site that works without an account and without a network for printed pages.
Departments share one kit, so every section looks and behaves the same.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.intro: Three steps from an empty folder to a course site you can edit. Node 24 or later.

steps.title: Add it to Eleventy

items.title: A syllabus and schedule from data
items.description: Put the course, the calendar, grading and policies in small JSON files. The kit works out each meeting's date, skips holidays, marks today's class and prints the syllabus to PDF.

items.title: Slides you present from
items.description: Write each deck in Markdown. Speaker notes stay off the slide and land on a printable notes sheet, and every vocabulary slide becomes a glossary entry.

items.title: Practice worksheets students check themselves
items.description: Write questions in Markdown: choice, matching, fill in the blank, diagrams and code. Each answer links back to the slide that taught it, and answers stay in the student's browser.

items.title: Lesson plans only you see
items.description: Every class meeting gets a lesson plan and the speaker notes. The instructor build includes them and the student build leaves them out.

items.title: Your college's colors, light and dark
items.description: Set a handful of color tokens and every page, slide and worksheet follows, in light, dark and print. Each pair is checked for contrast.

items.title: Every component, rendered
items.description: A page for each component with its props and slots, examples in light, dark and phone widths, an accessibility check, and the color tokens it reads.

gallery.title: What you can build
gallery.intro: Four pages from the starter course, rendered by the kit. Open one, or browse every component.

accessibility.title: Accessibility is the baseline
accessibility.body: The kit targets WCAG 2.2 level AAA, or stricter, for every component, because its readers are students working on whatever device and in whatever light they have.

points.title: 7:1 text contrast
points.body: Every text token holds 7:1 or better on every ground it is used on, in light and dark. Unit tests check each pair.

points.title: Targets and focus
points.body: Controls are at least 44 pixels, with one solid focus ring that holds 3:1 or better.

points.title: Checked on every change
points.body: axe-core runs against every page in light, dark and forced colors. Reduced motion is honored.
